import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 2x2 subplot figure
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax1.set_title('Fraud vs Non-Fraud by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], loc='upper right')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution for fraud vs non-fraud
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_data = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
non_fraud_data = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
ax2.hist([non_fraud_data, fraud_data], bins=30, alpha=0.7, label=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# 3. Fraud pattern by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count']) * 100
ax3.bar(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box plot of amounts by fraud status and transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Non-Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label', 
            ax=ax4, palette={'Non-Fraud': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'})
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.legend(title='Status', loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
